design.description: Minimal single-head attention with a bounded QUANTISED KV-cache. score[s] = sum_c q[c]*K[s][c]; out[c] = sum_s sign(score[s])*V[s][c]. K and V are stored as sign + QUANT_W magnitude bits.
design.kv_cache_location: on-chip fabric (registers/LUTs). No BRAM primitive inferred; no external DRAM.

methodology.power: ESTIMATED only (Vivado report_power unavailable); resource deltas are MEASURED
methodology.latency: DERIVED from the combinational depth (SLOTS x HEAD_DIM MAC steps), not measured on silicon

findings.claim: DSP48E1 = 0 in every attention configuration, including the 8x16 and 8x32 KV caches
RAMB = 0 in every configuration: the KV cache stayed in fabric LUT/FF and no RAM primitive was inferred; external DRAM reads per token = 0 and KV traffic = 0 bytes/token

At HEAD_DIM=8, KV_LEN=16: QUANT_W=4 -> 15,900 LUTs (13,869 LCs); QUANT_W=6 -> 24,197 LUTs (21,290 LCs); QUANT_W=8 -> 32,351 LUTs (28,619 LCs). Going 4-bit -> 8-bit costs +103% LUTs and +106% LCs. Halving the KV cache width halves the attention cost.
findings.decision: ADOPT QUANT_W=4 as the default KV quantisation for the edge-scale target, subject to the quality floor

findings.claim: At KV_LEN=16, QUANT_W=8: HEAD_DIM=4 -> 15,852 LUTs; HEAD_DIM=8 -> 32,351 LUTs (+104%)

The combinational attention form costs 28,619 estimated LCs = 21.3% of the XC7A200T LUT fabric (134,600 LCs) for a single 8-channel head with a 16-slot KV cache. On a 134k-LUT device this alone disqualifies the combinational form for anything larger.
findings.decision: REJECT the combinational form. A sequential form (one KV slot per cycle) is required and is the next iteration.

findings.claim: Measured LCs saturate from KV_LEN=8 onward (28,627 / 28,619 / 28,430 / 28,476 for KV_LEN 8/16/32/64). This saturation is a HARNESS ARTIFACT: every KV slot is written with the same rotating counter pattern, so the mux trees collapse. The real per-slot cost is NOT characterised by this sweep.
findings.limitation: A randomised KV payload sweep is required to characterise per-slot cost honestly. Recorded as a known gap, not hidden.

derived_latency.note: A sequential form would trade this for SLOTS cycles (e.g. 16 cycles = 107 ns) at a fraction of the LUT cost. Not yet built.

quality.note: No attention quality metric (e.g. attention-output MSE vs a CPU golden) has been computed yet. The resource sweep alone cannot justify a quality claim. Next iteration.

power.note: Power is not measured. The 28,619-LC attention form would dominate board power if built, so a sequential form is required before any power claim is meaningful.

next_iteration: build the sequential attention form (one KV slot per cycle) and measure its LUT/FF cost against the combinational form
randomise the KV payload so the per-slot cost is characterised honestly
compute an attention quality metric against a CPU golden
re-measure the accumulator peak with the attention path present (the co-design decision from iteration 1 may change)
